gauntlet: question
The repaired ticket row "The report-view setting uses the shared settings resolver." is in-scope as written. I'm taking that as settled, so the new setting's default lives in `settings/resolver.ts:12` and `ui/report-view.ts:30` reads it the same way it reads existing settings.

One behavior is still open. When a user switches workspaces, what should happen to the report filters that are currently active?

A) Clear them on every switch, so the new workspace opens with the resolver's default filters.
B) Remember filters per workspace, so returning to a workspace restores its last filters and a new workspace opens with defaults.
C) Keep filters across the switch, but drop any filter that doesn't apply to the new workspace.
D) other - name it

Recommendation: A - it removes the hidden-rows symptom outright, and it needs only one resolver-owned default with no per-workspace state.

What should happen to active report filters when the workspace changes?
A) Reset filters on every workspace change so the new workspace starts unfiltered.
B) Restore each workspace’s previous filters, with an unfiltered initial state for workspaces not visited before.
C) Other - name the desired behavior.
Recommendation: A - it directly prevents filters from the previous workspace from hiding rows, without introducing per-workspace filter persistence.
